title: The Red Ball
summary: 宠物玩耍:主角和小狗 Max 玩红球,扔球、狗狗叼回,一起开心。
text: {{name}} has a dog. The dog is Max. Max is little and white. {{name}} has a red ball. "Look, Max! Look at the ball!" The ball goes up. The ball goes down. Max runs to the ball. Max gets the ball. Good dog, Max! {{name}} is happy. Max is happy too.

questions.prompt: Is Max happy at the end?
